summary: Crypto sentiment today is constructive, with Bitcoin and Ether extending gains on strong ETF demand while several analysts are highlighting a broader altcoin rebound into Q4. Commodities are mixed-to-soft: gold is under pressure from higher yields and a stronger dollar, while Brent/WTI are easing after recent supply-driven spikes.
